itemList.description: Geophysical Investigation of site for sinking Borewell Geophysical Investigation of site for sinking Borewell for supplying drinking water to the habitation either through a hand pump, Mini Water Supply scheme, or Piped Water Supply Scheme by vertical electrical sounding by adopting venner or Schlumberger's method, including reconnaissance survey of geological formation, geophysical investigation of existing ground water in the vicinity, its quality, quantity & acceptability of the users indicating the location of site, recommended depth of casing pipe required to seal the top unconsolidated formation incluing an extra depth of 1.0 metre in consolidated formation for proper seating of casing pipe, depth of drilling required to cover full depth of aquifer proposed to be tapped, probable yield and other information required including transportation of instrument and accessories to work site, engaging technical personal and labour required etc., complete Vol-5, P.No-140, I No-12.4

Providing, supplying to work site, Submersible Pump Set of 150mm dia suitable for bore well and confirming to IS 8034-2000;3Phase, SS Bowl & Impeller with Low volt Motor as per specifications, as per necessary ammendments and instructions of engineer incharge of work. For 5.0 HP. Submersible Pump Set : Supply and delivery at site brand new Board approved make suitable HP deep well submersible pumpset suitable for vertical installation in 150mm dia bore wells comprising of single stage or multistage CF pump coupled to suitable HP suitable speed totally enclosed and filled with pure drinking water (wet type) squirrel operation on 3Ph, 50Hz, 380/440 volts AC supply fitted with required accessories such as suction casing, strainers, sand guard, non-return valve etc., complete. PUMP: The submersible pump conforming to the latest IS 8043 (1989) shall comprise of the following : a. Bowl assembly with required number of closed grained cast iron castings hydraulically tested with its inner passage smooth finished and coated with zinc chrome to ensure better efficiency and less wear. Every stage bowl shall be provided with a bronze wearing. b) Mixed flow "OR" radial flow impeller shall be made of bronze and shall be balanced both statically and dynamically. c) A stainless steel pump shaft provided with bearings sleeves made of leaded bronze. d) Close grained cast iron suction casing sheathed with strainer to avoid ingress or bigger particles. e) Top pump casing shall be provided with a non-return valve fully streamlined for minimum friction. The non-return valve shall be suitable for flanged connections. SUBMERSIBLE MOTORS:- Totally enclosed motor filled squirrel cage induction motor conforming to the latest IS 9283-1995 shall be of wet type design suitable for water cooling and water lubricating. The submersible motor shall be fitted with the following: a. Seamless steel tube outer motor casing. b.The stator shall be made of steel and shall be statically and dynamically balanced, the stator laminations shall be chemically tested and pressed under high pressure. The stator shall be vacuum impregnated with varnish from inside and epoxy painted outside shall be baked to ensure long life. The stator winding wire shall be of high quality electrical grade electrolytic copper provided with heat resistant coating and water proof, water resistant, hard PVC insulated tested of high voltage. The winding wire shall be of adequate current carrying capacity. c. The motor shall be made of high quality stampings the rotor lamination shall be stacked and fitted with electrical grade electrolytic copper bars and endrings. The rotor shall be mounted on stainless steel motor shaft and shall have stainless steel sleeves at the bearing end. The rotor shall be dynamically balanced to ensure vibration free operation. d. The motor shall be provided with Fixed/Mitchell type antifriction thrust bearing which is designed to withstand axial thrust loads with minimum wear and tear. A reflex pressure compensating device to guard against any rise in pressure shall be provided at the bottom. MATERIAL OF CONSTRUCTION: PUMP: Casing CI grade FG 200 IS 210/1978. Pump Shaft: Stainless steel AISI 410. Shaft Sleeves & Bearing Bush: Bronze LTB 3,4 or 5 of IS 318. Impeller: Bronze LTB2 of IS 318 - 1981/SS. Diffuser: CI - FG 200 of IS 210-1978. Wearing Ring: Bronze - LTB 3,4 or 5 of IS 318. Coupling: Stainless steel - AISI 410. MOTOR: Motor Casing: Seamless MS tubes. Motor Shaft: Stainless Steel AISI 410. Bearing Bush: LTB 3,4 or 5 IS 318-1981. Thrust Bearing: LTB 3,4 or 5 of IS 318-1981. Breather diaphragm: Nitrile Rubber. 5.00 HP - 120 LPM @ 88 m = 14 STG Outlet Dia - 2.00"
 Vol-5, P.No-152, I No-13.13.5

Supply and delivery brand new MCB (miniature circuit breaker) of required capacity's per IS 8828 - 78 and its latest amendments with ISI mark 16/25/50/63 Amps with sealable box. b) b) Control panel for control of submersible pumpsets shall be fitted with the following : 1 No. Triple pole power heavy duty rotary type motor controls switch. 1 No. triple pole fuse base with suitable capacity HRC fuses. 1No.72mm dia circular pattern projection panel mounting type suitable sealed moving iron ammeters with three way and off selector switch. 1 set of phase indicating lamps filament type of low watt consumption provided with series resistors wherever necessary and with translucent lamp covers, 1No.indicating lamp for motor on filament type of low watt consumption provided with series resistors wherever necessary and with translucent lamps cover, 1 No. current sensing type single phase preventer cum phase sequence relay. 1No push button operated fully automatic air break contactor operated direct online starter with thermal over load relay, in sheets steel housing for pumpsets upto 6.5 HP. 1 No. suitable capacity triple pole load break switch with HRC fuses for capacitor. 1 No. Lamp holder with taggle switch for lighting purpose. 1 No. ELR/ELCB of suitable capacity. NOTE : 1) Provision shall be made in the Panel board for mounting capacitor up to 12 KVAR capacity. 2) The panel board shall be complete with all the required fittings. 3) The panel board is required for outdoor installation in the open field. 4) The box shall be provided with earthing and GI earth strip of size 25x3mm, 200mm long with 6 holes provided for earthing terminals. All the individual lead shall be terminated on the earth strip by strip by suitable terminator. 5) The unit shall be fabricated using 16 SWG sheet steel and mounted on a pedestal fabricated using 50 x 50 x 6 mm size angle iron. 6) The internal wiring of the panel board wiring shall be done using 1.1KV grade copper conductor PVC insulated cable conforming to the IS 694. 7) The panel shall be painted with two coats of anticorrosive primer and one coat of weather proof synthetic enamel ash grey shade paint. 8) The capacity of motor control switch shall be as under.a) Minimum 16 amps capacity for pumpsets upto 5 HP. b) Minimum 25 amps capacity for pumpsets upto 12.5 HP. c) Minimum 50 amps capacity for pumpsets upto 20 HP. d) Minimum 63 amps capacity for pumpsets upto 30 HP.
